senses.gloss: पिण्ड- + खर्जूर पिण्ड- + खर्जूर, m. and f. री, A sort of date tree.
पिण्ड- + पात्र पिण्ड- + पात्र, n. 1. the vessel in which cakes are offered to the Manes. 2. alms (properly, [] the pot for receiving food).

पिण्ड् पिण्ड्, probably akin to पिष्, i. 1, Ātm., and i. 10, Par.
 1. To accumulate.
 2. To assemble. पिण्डित,
 1. Gathered, Kathās. 26, 283; collected, MBh. 10, 622; massy, solid, close.
 2. Multiplied, MBh. 7, 4746.
 3. Thick.
 --With सम् सम्, To heap together, MBh. 10, 8310. संपिण्डित, Clenched, united.

पिण्ड पिण्ड, probably akin to पिष्,
 I. m., f. डी, and n.
 1. A lump, Pañc. 136, 2; a heap, a cluster, a quantity, Kathās. 4, 81.
 2. A ball, a globe, a [] little button, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 19.
 II. m. n.
 1. A mouthful, or roundish lump of food, Man. 11, 216.
 2. Food.
 3. Livelihood, means of living, MBh. 1, 4148.
 4. Alms, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 15.
 5. The body.
 6. An object, Bhāṣāp. 123.
 7. An oblation to deceased ancestors, as a ball or lump of meat, or rice mixed up with milk, curds, flowers, etc., and offered to the manes at the several Śrāddhas by the nearest surviving relations; the funeral cake, Man. 3, 215.
 III. f. डी, A plant, Jonesia aśoka, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 10; cf. 184, 7.
 --Comp.

पिण्डक पिण्ड + क,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A lump, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 11.
 2. A lump of food, Hariv. 14740.
 3. The frontal globes of an elephant in rut, MBh. 1, 5471.
 II. f. डिका, A fleshy part of the body, Yājñ. 3, 97; as the [] calf, MBh. 14, 2582.
 --Comp.
पिण्डतस् पिण्ड + तस्, adv. Of a lump, Hit. Pr. d. 33.
पिण्डत्व पिण्ड + त्व, n. State of a mass, density; figuratively, Kathās. 11, 44.

पिण्डद पिण्ड-द, adj., f. दा.
 1. Who or what gives the funeral cake to deceased ancestors, Yājñ. 2, 132.
 2. Giving a mouthful of food, Bhartṛ. 2, 56.
पिण्डन पिण्ड् + अन, n. Forming globes, taking a globular form (as water), Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 43.
पिण्डमय पिण्ड + मय, adj. Consisting of a lump (of clay), Mṛcch. 47, 9.

पिण्डवत् पिण्ड + वत्, adv. Like a ball.
 --Comp.

पिण्याक पिण्याक (probably from पिष्, cf. पुण्य), m.
 1. The sediments of seed, etc., ground for oil, oil-cake, Man. 11, 92.
 2. Assafœtida.
पिण्ड- + भृति पिण्ड- + भृति, f. livelihood, Rām. 2, 26, 37 Gorr.
पिण्डी- + लेप पिण्डी- + लेप, m. a kind of ointment, Kathās. 28, 178.
पिण्डी- + शूर पिण्डी- + शूर (see पिण्ड), m. a hero at dinner.
